Hi Alex / Priya,

Thanks again for your time today — really helpful to understand CrestPay's throughput and compliance needs. As discussed, the next step that will be most useful is a 30-minute product demo + quick tech Q&A so we can:

- Walk through how Redwood handles routing and cost controls for high-throughput payment flows
- Show the Dedicated/private deployment options and audit/logging surfaces (SOC2/retention)
- Surface quantization and batching settings that typically reduce per-token costs for payment workloads

Proposed 30-minute slots (PT):
1) Tue 2026-11-17, 9:00-9:30 AM PT — for product + PMs (can cover high-level flows)
2) Tue 2026-11-17, 1:00-1:30 PM PT — for product + infra/ops (deeper on networking and VPC)
3) Wed 2026-11-18, 11:00-11:30 AM PT — combined session (we can keep it tight)

Suggested attendees from our side: me (product), Marissa (solutions engineer). If you prefer, we can include an engineer who can deep-dive on private deployment/networking.

Attached: Redwood product one-pager and a short 30-min demo agenda. Please reply with the option that works best or share a calendar link and we'll send a calendar invite.

Thanks,
